action_classes.other: every other candidate: switch_to_backup, repair_link, replace_io_module on other targets
action_classes.other_observe: every other observe-family candidate: query_historian, trace_link / verify_sensor on other targets
action_classes.repair_pair: repair_link on sensor:<g> or replace_io_module on source:<g>

definitions.ambiguous_decisions: decisions of episodes whose incident is a link fault on sensor:<g> or an I/O-module fault on <g> (dataset.in_family = dec_family); g = belief.family_group(incident)
definitions.argmin_set_changed: the set of co-optimal candidates under J_belief with the shifted posterior differs
definitions.belief_minus_hindsight: strictly-best share under belief minus hindsight labels on the with_both decisions; 95% paired cluster bootstrap over episodes (eval.metrics.paired_cluster_bootstrap_diff)
definitions.calibration: P(link | E) of ambiguous decisions with a defined posterior, 10 equal bins (dataset_stats.calibration_table): ECE (count-weighted |mean p - frequency|) and Brier
definitions.calibration_null: ECE with outcomes drawn as independent Bernoulli(p) from the same posteriors, n_null draws, rng seed fixed (the same for every subgroup)
definitions.class_co_optimal_share: share of decisions in which the class holds a co-optimal candidate
definitions.class_unique_argmin_share: share of decisions whose argmin is a single candidate of the class
definitions.co_optimal_D: D holds a co-optimal candidate; denominator: all ambiguous decisions of the subset
definitions.development_pool: train + val raw episodes, split by seed (dataset.split_of, fractions 0.6/0.2/0.2) before a file is opened (dataset_stats.load_episodes); any other split is refused
definitions.gather_flipped: D0 strictly best (gather-or-act answer) differs between the stored and shifted posterior
definitions.groupwide_staleness: stale alerts valid at tau (decision valid_evidence) on at least max(2, stale_fraction * group size) distinct channels of a sensor group (agents/playbook.Playbook.plan, stale_fraction 0.5)

info_classes.diagnostic: no physical effect, own result discriminates the pair (trace_link_pair, verify_sensor_pair, escalate)

definitions.labels: hindsight: J of the true cause (dataset.candidate_labels); belief: J_belief = P(c|E) J(a|c) + P(c'|E) J(a|c',h) (dataset.belief_labels); twin world: J(a|c',h), the twin's branch labels
definitions.minus_historian: paired label difference J(tool) - J(query_historian on source:<g>) in the true world (hindsight labels) and the twin world (twin labels), common random numbers
definitions.onset_shift: both worlds' assumed onsets moved by delta; link-world state records the true onset alone explains are set to the state the assumed onset implies; evidence rebuilt with belief.belief_evidence from the primary's stored items and the stored state timelines
definitions.onset_uniform: likelihood of each cause averaged uniformly over the shifts, then the posterior
definitions.prior: pair_prior = (pi_L w_L(g)/W_L) / (pi_L w_L(g)/W_L + pi_M w_M(g)/W_M): pi type shares, w the group's sensor-link and module weights, W_L all link weights (sensor and actuator), W_M all module weights
definitions.settled: the twin's deterministic evidence differed by tau (deterministic_identical false): the posterior is exactly 0 or 1
definitions.since_onset_terciles: post-onset decisions split at the 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of tau - onset
definitions.strictly_best: Eq. gap with class D in place of the observe family: min J over D < min J over the other candidates - TOL; denominator (with_both): decisions with candidates in D and outside D. D0 is the datasheet's gather-beats-act (dataset_stats: gather_belief, voi.gather_beats_act)
definitions.subgroup_ece_range: over backup availability, decision index and since-onset tercile subgroups
definitions.tie_share: share of decisions with more than one co-optimal candidate; cross_class_tie_share: whose co-optimal candidates fall in more than one class
definitions.trace_share_of_observe: decisions in which trace_link_pair is co-optimal / decisions in which an observe-family candidate is co-optimal (belief labels)

log: natural: 800 episodes, 3129 decisions, 1324 ambiguous (1324 with belief labels); 6s
stress: 800 episodes, 4795 decisions, 2790 ambiguous (2790 with belief labels); 8s
